say: God takes care of us like a shepherd takes care of his sheep!
say_sw: Mungu anatutunza kama mchungaji anavyowatunza kondoo wake!
verse: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

say: God made the light! Everything was dark, and then God said a word.
say_sw: Mungu aliumba nuru! Kila kitu kilikuwa giza, kisha Mungu akasema neno.
verse: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.
For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

say: The shepherd takes his sheep to soft green grass and cool water.
say_sw: Mchungaji huwapeleka kondoo wake kwenye majani laini ya kijani na maji ya baridi.
verse: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.
